cases.name: arrays-functions
cases.source:
10 DIM a(3): DIM b$(3,8)
20 DATA 2,"one",4,"two",6,"three"
30 FOR i=1 TO 3: READ a(i),b$(i): NEXT i
40 RESTORE 20: READ x,y$
50 DEF FN f(n)=n*n
60 DEF FN g$(s$)=s$(2 TO )
70 LET z=FN f(a(3)): LET c$=FN g$(b$(2))
80 OPEN #4,"s": PRINT #4;z;c$: CLOSE #4
90 IF z<>36 OR c$<>"wo     " OR x<>2 OR y$<>"one" THEN PRINT "CORE FAIL": STOP
100 PRINT "CORE OK"

cases.name: cassette
cases.source:
10 SAVE "program" LINE 10: LOAD "": VERIFY "program": MERGE "extra"
20 SAVE "numbers" DATA a(): LOAD "strings" DATA b$(): VERIFY "numbers" DATA a()
30 SAVE "screen" SCREEN$: LOAD "screen" SCREEN$: VERIFY "screen" SCREEN$
40 SAVE "bytes" CODE 32768,16: LOAD "bytes" CODE: VERIFY "bytes" CODE 32768
50 LIST #2;15: LLIST #3,10

cases.name: channels
cases.source:
10 OPEN #4,"s": PRINT #4;"channel": CLOSE #4
20 POKE 32768,1: OUT 254,0: COPY
30 CAT: FORMAT "m": MOVE "old","new": ERASE "old"
40 RANDOMIZE 1: RESTORE: RUN: NEW

cases.name: control-flow
cases.source:
10 LET total=0: FOR i=3 TO 1 STEP -1: LET total=total+i: NEXT i
20 IF total=6 THEN GO SUB 100: IF total>0 THEN PRINT total: GO TO 40
30 PRINT "missed"
40 RUN 50
50 RANDOMIZE: CLEAR: GO TO 70
60 CONTINUE
70 STOP
100 LET total=total+1: RETURN

cases.name: expressions
cases.source:
10 LET a=1: LET b$="2"
20 PRINT RND;PI;INKEY$;SIN a;COS a;TAN a;ASN a;ACS a;ATN a;LN a;EXP a;INT a;SQR a;SGN a;ABS a;PEEK a;IN a;USR a
30 PRINT STR$ a;CHR$ a;CODE b$;VAL b$;VAL$ b$;LEN b$;USR b$;POINT(a,a);ATTR(a,a);SCREEN$(a,a)
40 PRINT BIN 101;NOT a;-a;+a;a^2*3/4+5-6;a<=2;a>=2;a<>2;a<2;a>2;a=2;a AND 2;a OR 2;b$ AND a

cases.name: graphics
cases.source:
10 BORDER 1: PAPER 7: INK 0: BRIGHT 1: FLASH 0: INVERSE 0: OVER 0: CLS
20 PLOT INK 2;10,10: DRAW PAPER 7,20,20,PI/2: CIRCLE OVER 1;100,80,20
30 BEEP .1,12: PRINT AT 0,0;"GRAPHICS";TAB 12;POINT(10,10)
40 PRINT ATTR(0,0);SCREEN$(0,0): PAUSE 1

cases.name: input-print
cases.source:
10 DIM a(3): DIM b$(3,8)
20 INPUT ("Name: ";AT 1,2);LINE b$(1);a(1),#0;"?"
30 INPUT ;,,' : INPUT ()
40 PRINT AT 1,2;INK 3;PAPER 7;FLASH 0;BRIGHT 1;INVERSE 0;OVER 0;TAB 8;"a""b",a(1)'
50 LPRINT #3;AT 1,2;TAB 4;"print";b$(1,2 TO 3)

cases.name: rem-slices
cases.source:
10 REM Raw: PRINT 1E999 "unfinished {{0xFF}} \\n
20 LET a$="a""b:c": LET a$(2 TO 3)="XY": PRINT a$()(2 TO );("abc"+a$)(TO 3)
30 IF 1 THEN : PRINT "tail": REM : CLS "unfinished
40 : PRINT BIN :
